description: This file defines an interface `ExponentialBackOffConfig` that specifies configuration settings for an exponential back-off strategy, including methods to get minimum and maximum durations, a random factor, and a timeout. It also contains an enum `ExponentialBackOffConfigValue` listing configuration keys and default values.

classes.name: ExponentialBackOffConfig
classes.description: An interface that provides configuration settings for an exponential back-off strategy, including methods to retrieve min/max durations, random factor, and timeout.

classes.name: ExponentialBackOffConfig.ExponentialBackOffConfigValue
classes.description: An enum implementing KnownConfigValue, providing configuration keys and default values for back-off parameters.

methods.name: getMin
methods.description: Returns the minimal exponential back-off duration.

methods.name: getMax
methods.description: Returns the maximal exponential back-off duration.

methods.name: getRandomFactor
methods.description: Returns the random factor of the exponential back-off strategy.

methods.name: getCorruptedReceiveTimeout
methods.description: Returns the maximum idle time before a corrupted supervisor terminates.
